programme.title: From Hell To Victory
programme.desc: On August 24, 1939, at a small French cafe, six friends are about to go their separate ways. They vow to reunite on that day each year at the cafe. On the day Paris is liberated, the three surviving friends meet at the cafe and get drunk.

Before very long, though, Ruby suspects that Erin and Terry may not be the ideal guardians they seemed to be.
